## Description

Plans and trial (from F-01 "start free trial"), seat counting (doctors/staff), subscription invoices to clinics with GST (India) / VAT (UAE) under Medvya's own numbering, payment collection, dunning (reminders, grace period, read-only mode — never blocking access to patient records needed for care).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Pricing decision is recorded (ADR) before implementation.
- [ ] **AC2.** Trial converts to paid with correct tax invoice; seat changes prorate.
- [ ] **AC3.** Dunning never blocks clinicians from reading existing patient records (safety rule); it limits new features/admin.
- [ ] **AC4.** Subscription data lives in the platform control plane with no PHI.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
